messages:
Alex (Finance): Received invoice LC-889 from LumenCore for $12,450 (GL 4001 / 4022). PDF attached but no PO on the invoice 1 AP put it on hold. Can procurement confirm match or routing?
Marta (Procurement): Please upload the PDF here so I can check PO registry.
Alex (Finance): https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/LC-889.pdf — uploaded.
LumenCore AP: Vendor uploaded a corrected PDF shortly. They believe the intended PO is PO-9921 but may have transposed digits.
Jeff (Ops): Note we have blanket PO BLT-432 for LumenCore through 2025. For change orders vendors sometimes reference BLT-432/CO-7.
Marta (Procurement): Searching PO system... I can see PO-9920 (closed). PO-9921 not found. BLT-432 is active and covers vendor, but this charge looks like a one-off services add-on. If Ops signs off, AP can match to BLT-432.
Jeff (Ops): Confirmed — this is an out-of-scope professional services invoice that should be charged to BLT-432. Previous approver Sam signed similar items last quarter but he left in January.
Marta (Procurement): Who is the current approver for these one-offs? Need someone to approve reuse of BLT-432 so AP can clear hold.
Alex (Finance): AP requires either an attached PO or an approval note from the cost owner to release the hold.
Nina (Approver): I can act as the interim approver for Sam's queue this quarter for ad-hoc charges. I approve charging BLT-432 for this invoice. Please add a procurement memo referencing BLT-432 and tag me.
Marta (Procurement): Adding procurement confirmation: "BLT-432 covers LumenCore; invoice LC-889 approved to GL 4001 (70%) / 4022 (30%). Acting approver: Nina." Procurement memo attached.
ap_bot: System update — invoice LC-889 updated, procurement memo attached, routed to Accounts Payable queue #4521.
LumenCore AP: Uploaded corrected invoice LC-889-v2.pdf including PO reference BLT-432/CO-7 in header and remittance instructions.
Alex (Finance): Received updated invoice with PO reference. Matching OK, releasing hold and scheduling payment on next AP run. :white_check_mark:
Nina (Approver): Approved for payment. Thanks all.
Jeff (Ops): Can procurement add a short audit note explaining PO reuse justification?
Marta (Procurement): Will add internal audit note on the PO record and close loop. Closing thread.
